description: List the crypto coins with prices, in symbol order: symbol, pair, whether it still trades and its first stored trade date. Coins are known by symbol only (BTC, ETH); there are no coin names, market caps or supplies. query keeps the symbols that start with it. Prices are in US dollars from one exchange. Use GetCryptoQuote for the latest price, GetCryptoPrices for daily candles and GetCryptoIntradayPrices for candles within the day. Included on every plan.

offset.description: Coins to skip, for the next page (default: 0)

query.description: Start of a coin symbol, e.g. BT (default: every coin)

name: ListCryptoAssets
title: Crypto Coins
